newsitem.title: SPAIN: BoS buys pesetas for marks around 84.74/75 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BoS buys pesetas for marks around 84.74/75 - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain bought pesetas versus marks at about 84.74/75, dealers said on Friday.
At around 1220 GMT, right after the central bank was said to intervene, the peseta was trading at 84.70/75 after hitting a low at 84.76.
The Bank of Spain did not, as is its practice, comment on these rumours.
On Thursday too, dealers were suggesting the Bank of Spain could have sold marks and bought pesetas in order to strengthen the weak Spanish currency.
